title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
prompt: Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return its head.
hints: Use two pointers. Move first pointer n steps ahead. Then move both until first reaches the end.
The second pointer will be at the node before the one to delete. Use a dummy node to handle removing the head.
Dummy -> head. Left = dummy, Right = head. Move right n times. Then move both until right hits null.
left.next = left.next.next to skip the nth node. Return dummy.next.
